test_title: PYST 14: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"vary."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Vary"** means to change or differ from one another. ((एक ही प्रकार की वस्‍तुओं के समूह का) एक-दूसरे से भिन्‍न होना)

 
 
• **Example**: *The prices of vegetables **vary**__ according to the season.*
 
 
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank, as it fits the context of the sentence.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
 
• **Correct passage**:

Seasonal winds are a natural phenomenon that __**affects**__ weather patterns across the globe. These winds are caused by the sun's unequal heating of the earth's surface, which creates differences in temperature and pressure between different regions. The movement of air from high-pressure areas to low-pressure areas causes seasonal winds to form, and their direction and intensity __**vary**__ depending .........

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Fluctuate** means to change frequently or irregularly. ((क़ीमतों और संख्‍याओं या जनभावनाओं में) बार-बार उतार-चढ़ाव होना)
 
• **Transform** means to change completely in form or nature. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्‍तु को पूरी तरह बदल देना (विशेषतया उसमें सुधार लाते हुए), (का) रूपांतरण कर देना)
 
• **Mutate** means to undergo a genetic change or mutation. ((आनुवंशिकता में परिवर्तन के कारण) नवीन रूप या संरचना का विकास होना या उसे विकसित करना, उत्‍परिवर्तन होना, करना)

The correct answer is **"impact."**
